column1: # input/<env>/partner-aliases.tsv — hand-curated partner tokens naming ONE
# organisation (bin/flow-manager.sh merge rule 4). Two TAB-separated tokens =
# one organisation, variant<TAB>CANONICAL (the right side outranks the rest
# when the alias star names a merged group). A SINGLE token on its own line
# is HISTORICAL (it exempted the token from the retired name-split helper
# lists) — tolerated and inert since the logical-based derivation.
# SAMPLE ESTATE: the misspelled GLOBEXX accounts are GLOBEX; the WONKA
# variants form an alias STAR (the merged group takes the star's name); P2P
# is the SETTLE clearing flows' real counterparty, not a qualifier.
